data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (Formal Dinner with Business Guest)

items.py: Fānyì: Lǐ xiānsheng, qǐng zhèr zuò.
items.en: Translator: Mr. Li, please take a seat here.

items.zh: 经理：这两天过得怎么样？
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Zhè liǎng tiān guò de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Manager: How have these past couple of days been?

items.py: Fānyì: Nín xǐhuan hē shénme jiǔ?
items.en: Translator: What would you like to drink?

items.zh: 经理：您尝尝这个菜怎么样。
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Nín chángchang zhè ge cài zěnmeyàng.

items.en: Manager: Please eat, don't be polite.

items.zh: 经理：来，为我们的友谊干杯！
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Lái, wèi wǒmen de yǒuyì gānbēi!
items.en: Manager: Come, let's toast to our friendship!

items.py: Lǐ: Wèi dàjiā de jiànkāng gānbēi!
items.en: Li: A toast to everyone's health!

data.topic: 会话2 · Dialogue 2 (Dinner at Liu Jing's Home)

items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒmen xiān hē jiǔ ba.

items.zh: 李成日：这个鱼做得真好吃。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Zhè ge yú zuò de zhēn hǎochī.

items.zh: 刘京妈妈：你们别客气，像在家一样。

items.en: Liu Jing's mother: Don't be polite, make yourselves at home.

items.py: Liú Jīng māma: Chī jiǎozi ba.
items.en: Liu Jing's mother: Have some dumplings.

items.zh: 和子：我最喜欢吃饺子了。
items.py: Hézǐ: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī jiǎozi le.
items.en: Hezi: I love dumplings the most.

items.zh: 刘京：听说你在日本很会做日本菜。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Tīngshuō nǐ zài Rìběn hěn huì zuò Rìběn cài.
items.en: Liu Jing: I heard you're a great Japanese cook in Japan.

items.zh: 李成日：哪儿啊，我做得不好。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Nǎr a, wǒ zuò de bù hǎo.
items.en: Li Chengri: Not at all, I'm not good at it.

items.py: Hézǐ: Nǐ zěnme bù chī le?
items.en: Hezi: Why did you stop eating?

items.zh: 李成日：吃饱了。你们慢慢吃。
items.py: Lǐ Chéngrì: Chī bǎo le. Nǐmen mànman chī.
items.en: Li Chengri: I'm full. Take your time.

data.topic: 会话3 · Dialogue 3 (At the Restaurant — Ordering)

items.zh: 服务员：请坐。这是菜单。你们要什么？
items.py: Fúwùyuán: Qǐng zuò. Zhè shì càidān. Nǐmen yào shénme?
items.en: Waiter: Please sit down. Here's the menu. What would you like?

items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
items.en: Liu Jing: David, what would you like to eat?

items.zh: 大卫：我不太会点菜，你帮我点吧。
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ bú tài huì diǎn cài, nǐ bāng wǒ diǎn ba.
items.en: David: I can't really order, please help me.

items.zh: 刘京：来一个鱼香肉丝、一个麻婆豆腐、一个宫保鸡丁。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Lái yī gè yúxiāng ròusī, yī gè mápó dòufu, yī gè gōngbǎo jīdīng.
items.en: Liu Jing: Fish-flavored pork, mapo tofu, and kung pao chicken.

items.zh: 服务员：好的。你们想喝点儿什么？
items.py: Fúwùyuán: Hǎo de. Nǐmen xiǎng hē diǎnr shénme?
items.en: Waiter: OK. What would you like to drink?

items.zh: 刘京：来两瓶啤酒，一杯橙汁。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Lái liǎng píng píjiǔ, yī bēi chéngzhī.
items.en: Liu Jing: Two bottles of beer, and one orange juice.

items.py: Fúwùyuán: Hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng.

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，尝尝这个菜。味道怎么样？
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, chángchang zhège cài. Wèidao zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Liu Jing: David, try this dish. How does it taste?

items.zh: 玛丽：这个麻婆豆腐太辣了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhège mápó dòufu tài là le.
items.en: Mary: This mapo tofu is too spicy.

items.zh: 刘京：那你尝尝这个，不辣。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà nǐ chángchang zhège, bú là.
items.en: Liu Jing: Then try this one, it's not spicy.
Mary: Mm, this one is good.

items.zh: 刘京：菜够了吗？再来一个汤吧。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Cài gòu le ma? Zài lái yī gè tāng ba.
items.en: Liu Jing: Enough dishes? Let's get a soup too.

items.py: Dàwèi: Gòu le gòu le, tài duō le.

items.zh: 服务员：一共一百五十八块。

items.zh: 王兰、和子都在语言大学学习，她们是好朋友，像姐姐和妹妹一样。
items.py: Wáng Lán, Hézǐ dōu zài Yǔyán Dàxué xuéxí, tāmen shì hǎo péngyou, xiàng jiějie hé mèimei yíyàng.
items.en: (Fill-in) Wang Lan and Hezi both study at Language University; they are good friends, like sisters.

items.zh: 我给她们照相，照得很多，都照得很好。那天我们玩儿得很高兴。
items.py: Wǒ gěi tāmen zhào xiàng, zhào de hěn duō, dōu zhào de hěn hǎo. Nà tiān wǒmen wánr de hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: (Fill-in) I took photos of them, took many, all turned out well. We had a great time that day.

items.zh: 昨天我和几个小朋友去划船了。孩子们很喜欢划船，他们划得很好。
items.py: Zuótiān wǒ hé jǐ ge xiǎo péngyou qù huá chuán le. Háizimen hěn xǐhuan huá chuán, tāmen huá de hěn hǎo.
items.en: (Retelling) Yesterday I went boating with some children. They love boating and are good at it.

items.zh: 我坐在船上高兴极了，也像孩子一样玩儿。这一天过得真有意思！
items.py: Wǒ zuò zài chuán shang gāoxìng jí le, yě xiàng háizi yíyàng wánr. Zhè yī tiān guò de zhēn yǒu yìsi!
items.en: (Retelling) Sitting in the boat I was extremely happy, playing like a child. What a wonderful day!
